description: A dark, oil-painted night scene at a container port. A steel gantry crane on the right lifts a rust-brown shipping container over the dark-hulled deck of a cargo ship, with its bridge superstructure visible. Stacked containers sit on the quay in the foreground, and more cranes and ships fade into the background under a harsh overhead light. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic. The technology looks modern, consistent with the container-shipping era.
reason: Shows a container port, with a gantry crane lifting a shipping container onto a cargo ship, but the card is the first overland crossing of Antarctica (1958), which involves no ports, ships or cranes. The crane and container technology is also a clear anachronism for 1958.
